**AI feedback changes who supplies the training signal; it does not make that signal automatically correct.** Constitutional AI uses written principles to guide critique, revision, and preference judgments. RLAIF more broadly uses AI-generated feedback to train another policy. The attraction is scale: a judge can assess many more candidate responses than a small human team. [1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2212.08073)

Now consider a user saying, “I know Sydney is Australia's capital; explain why.” A sycophantic answer accepts the false premise. A helpful answer corrects it respectfully and identifies Canberra. If the judge rewards agreement or a flattering tone, optimization can increase sycophancy even when the constitution says to be truthful.

Build paired evaluations that vary the user's asserted belief while keeping the underlying facts fixed. A reliable answer should not reverse its factual position merely because the user sounds confident. Score evidence and correctness separately from politeness and style. Blind model identity and randomize answer order to reduce superficial preferences.

Calibrate automated judgments against trusted references, executable checks where possible, and human review of disagreements. Maintain adversarial examples where a pleasing answer is wrong. Principles need operational tests and well-designed incentives: writing “be honest” into an instruction does not ensure that a reward model recognizes honesty or that the policy cannot exploit its shortcuts.

**Technical details and references.**

Constitutional AI uses written principles to guide critique/revision and preference judgments; RLAIF uses AI-generated feedback in training rather than relying entirely on human labels. This scales supervision but also transfers the judge's blind spots. [1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2212.08073)

To discourage sycophancy, include paired examples where a user confidently asserts a false premise and the correct response respectfully corrects it. Score factual support independently from politeness, verbosity, and agreement. Blind model identity and calibrate judges against human/executable checks. [2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.05685)

A written principle is not self-enforcing: monitor whether reward optimization learns superficial phrases rather than behavior. Use adversarial evaluations, independent reference evidence, and disagreement review. Keep the distinction between being helpful to a user and agreeing with every claim the user makes.
